reason: As a salon owner who's loyal to my cousin, I'm reassured by Document A when it says Carla doesn't do tax returns, so my accountant keeps doing those and just gets clean books from her. A also gives me low-risk reasons to call: a free month if she misses the 10th, no contract, and six years managing a salon. Document B leaves the question of replacing my cousin open and offers only a vague 'I work hard' on the missed deadlines.
